purpose: Measure whether exposure to a 100k source-checked factual foundation improves new-entity action-consequence prediction, detect an out-of-grammar mechanism, and preserve prior rules. Do not confuse associative lookup or finite-family fitting with native cognition.

source.source_hidden_test_entity_ids: 6144..8191 (2048 entities), no causal result available to model before evaluation
source.source_input: entity binary properties obtained through public fact exposure, not from hidden world truth; 1 selected action=1 consequence per training entity

mechanisms.C: majority(property4,property5,property6), intentionally outside native 2-property truth-table grammar

arms: bounded two-property truth-table induction from public selected effects, source evidence min64
independent exhaustive two-property symbolic truth-table control, identical information and minimum support
fully trained conventional CART decision tree max_depth 4, same 512 public outcomes and same missing-property exposure
no knowledge records: public effects only

evaluation.primary: correct cold predictions / 2048 (abstentions count incorrect) per seed/world/exposure
evaluation.secondary: prediction coverage, confident wrong predictions, retained earlier model predictions after sequential different-family learning, action count, wall time
evaluation.guard: if no pairwise rule fits 64 or more complete source-visible support events without contradiction, abstain rather than synthesize a triple/majority law
evaluation.development_expectation: 100k exposure improves heldout coverage over 10k; two-property mechanisms A/B source-compatible; 3-property majority C triggers bounded NO_SUPPORTED_RELATION abstention
evaluation.science_reason: self-generated simulation, preprogrammed two-property rule grammar, independent exhaustive symbolic control is equally informed, no external authentic first-use or owner model integration
